workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Add policy to profile or template

properties.description: Adds one policy to a Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge profile/template without dropping unrelated PolicyBucket entries. Select an intersight.endpoint target authorized to read organization/profile/template collections and update selected resources. It validates route matrix, exact OData ownership/cardinality, policy Moid/ObjectType, bucket shape, SrcTemplate confirmation, and responses. Exact existing is idempotent; a different same-type entry returns 409 in Fail mode or is replaced in Replace mode. Server/Chassis patch the parent; Domain/Unified Edge preflight A/B children and PATCH complete arrays sequentially. Fabric B failure can leave a verified Fabric A change. Complete-array writes can race concurrent PolicyBucket writers and must be serialized; Intersight controls applicability and template derivation may overwrite a direct change. Generic APIs are used.

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

objectKind = sys.argv[10]
profileType = sys.argv[11]
organizationName = sys.argv[12]
objectName = sys.argv[13]
policyMoid = sys.argv[14]
policyObjectType = sys.argv[15]
conflictMode = sys.argv[17] or "Fail"
switchScopeInput = sys.argv[16]
confirmText = str(sys.argv[9]).strip().lower()

errors = []
allowedObjectKinds = {"Profile", "Template"}
allowedProfileTypes = {"Server", "Chassis", "Domain", "Unified Edge"}
allowedConflictModes = {"Fail", "Replace"}
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")
objectTypePattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$")

if objectKind not in allowedObjectKinds:
    errors.append("Object Kind must be Profile or Template.")
if profileType not in allowedProfileTypes:
    errors.append("Profile Type must be Server, Chassis, Domain, or Unified Edge.")
if not organizationName:
    errors.append("Organization must not be blank.")
if not objectName:
    errors.append("Object Name must not be blank.")
if not policyMoid:
    errors.append("Policy Moid must not be blank.")
elif not moidPattern.fullmatch(policyMoid):
    errors.append("Policy Moid must be a URL-safe identifier containing only letters, digits, period, underscore, tilde, or hyphen (maximum 128 characters).")
if not policyObjectType:
    errors.append("Policy Object Type must not be blank.")
elif len(policyObjectType) > 128 or not objectTypePattern.fullmatch(policyObjectType):
    errors.append("Policy Object Type must be a fully qualified type in namespace.Type form.")
if conflictMode not in allowedConflictModes:
    errors.append("Conflict Mode must be Fail or Replace.")

normalizedSwitchScope = switchScopeInput or "Both"
usesChildren = profileType in {"Domain", "Unified Edge"}
if usesChildren:
    if normalizedSwitchScope not in {"A", "B", "Both"}:
        errors.append("Switch Scope must be A, B, or Both for Domain or Unified Edge.")
else:
    if normalizedSwitchScope != "Both":
        errors.append("Switch Scope A or B applies only to Domain or Unified Edge; use Both for Server or Chassis.")

if confirmText in {"true", "1"}:
    confirmTemplateOverride = "true"
elif confirmText in {"false", "0", ""}:
    confirmTemplateOverride = "false"
else:
    confirmTemplateOverride = ""
    errors.append("Confirm Template Override must be a boolean value.")

validationStatus = "invalid" if errors else "valid"
validationError = " ".join(errors)
validationResult = json.dumps({"error":"Input validation failed","details":errors}, separators=(",",":"))
normalizedObjectKind = objectKind
normalizedProfileType = profileType
normalizedOrganizationName = organizationName
normalizedObjectName = objectName
escapedOrganizationName = ""
escapedObjectName = ""
parentCollection = ""
expectedParentObjectType = ""
parentSelect = ""
platformFilter = ""
expectedTargetPlatform = ""
usesChildObjects = "true" if usesChildren else "false"
childCollection = ""
expectedChildObjectType = ""
parentRelationshipName = ""
childSelect = ""

if validationStatus == "valid":
    escapedOrganizationName = sys.argv[18]
    escapedObjectName = sys.argv[19]
    route = (objectKind, profileType)
    routes = {
        ("Profile","Server"): ("server/Profiles","server.Profile"),
        ("Profile","Chassis"): ("chassis/Profiles","chassis.Profile"),
        ("Profile","Domain"): ("fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles","fabric.SwitchClusterProfile"),
        ("Profile","Unified Edge"): ("fabric/SwitchClusterProfiles","fabric.SwitchClusterProfile"),
        ("Template","Server"): ("server/ProfileTemplates","server.ProfileTemplate"),
        ("Template","Chassis"): ("chassis/ProfileTemplates","chassis.ProfileTemplate"),
        ("Template","Domain"): ("fabric/SwitchClusterProfileTemplates","fabric.SwitchClusterProfileTemplate"),
        ("Template","Unified Edge"): ("fabric/SwitchClusterProfileTemplates","fabric.SwitchClusterProfileTemplate")
    }
    parentCollection, expectedParentObjectType = routes[route]
    if usesChildren:
        expectedTargetPlatform = "UCS Domain" if profileType == "Domain" else "Unified Edge"
        platformFilter = " and TargetPlatform eq '" + expectedTargetPlatform.replace("'","''") + "'"
        parentSelect = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,Organization,TargetPlatform,SrcTemplate"
        if objectKind == "Profile":
            childCollection = "fabric/SwitchProfiles"
            expectedChildObjectType = "fabric.SwitchProfile"
            parentRelationshipName = "SwitchClusterProfile"
        else:
            childCollection = "fabric/SwitchProfileTemplates"
            expectedChildObjectType = "fabric.SwitchProfileTemplate"
            parentRelationshipName = "SwitchClusterProfileTemplate"
        childSelect = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,SwitchId,PolicyBucket,SrcTemplate,TargetPlatform," + parentRelationshipName
    else:
        parentSelect = "Moid,Name,ObjectType,Organization,PolicyBucket,SrcTemplate"

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
expectedName = sys.argv[1]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[2]
expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[10]
expectedPlatform = sys.argv[4]
objectKind = sys.argv[5]
profileType = sys.argv[6]
confirmTemplateOverride = sys.argv[7]
usesChildren = sys.argv[8]
objectStatus = 'invalid'
parentMoid = ''
sourceTemplatePresent = 'false'
failureStatusCode = '502'
failureStatusMessage = 'Profile or template response was malformed'
failureErrorMessage = 'The exact object response could not be validated.'
failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
parentSummary = '{}'
moidPattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')
objectTypePattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$')
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[9])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict):
        raise ValueError('The response is not a JSON object.')
    results = envelope.get('Results')
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError('The response does not contain a Results array.')
    if len(results) == 0:
        objectStatus = 'missing'
        failureStatusCode = '404'
        failureStatusMessage = objectKind + ' was not found'
        failureErrorMessage = 'The exact ' + sys.argv[11] + ' lookup returned zero matches.'
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'matchCount': 0, 'profileType': profileType}, separators=(',', ':'))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        objectStatus = 'cardinality'
        failureStatusCode = '409'
        failureStatusMessage = objectKind + ' lookup was ambiguous'
        failureErrorMessage = 'The exact ' + sys.argv[11] + ' lookup returned ' + str(len(results)) + ' matches; exactly one is required.'
        failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'matchCount': len(results), 'profileType': profileType}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError('The single result is not an object.')
        parentMoid = str(item.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(parentMoid):
            raise ValueError('The object does not contain a URL-safe Moid.')
        if str(item.get('Name', '')).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError('The returned Name does not match the normalized requested name.')
        if str(item.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != expectedObjectType:
            raise ValueError('The returned ObjectType does not match the routed concrete type.')
        organization = item.get('Organization')
        if not isinstance(organization, dict):
            raise ValueError('The object is missing its Organization relationship.')
        if str(organization.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedOrganizationMoid:
            raise ValueError('The returned Organization.Moid does not match the resolved organization.')
        if str(organization.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != 'organization.Organization':
            raise ValueError('The returned Organization relationship has an unexpected ObjectType.')
        if expectedPlatform and str(item.get('TargetPlatform', '')).strip() != expectedPlatform:
            raise ValueError('The returned TargetPlatform does not match Profile Type.')
        if usesChildren not in {'true', 'false'}:
            raise ValueError('The route helper returned an invalid child-route token.')
        if usesChildren == 'false':
            if 'PolicyBucket' not in item:
                raise ValueError('The direct object response omitted PolicyBucket.')
            bucket = item.get('PolicyBucket')
            if bucket is not None and (not isinstance(bucket, list)):
                raise ValueError('PolicyBucket is not an array or null.')
        src = item.get('SrcTemplate')
        if src not in (None, {}):
            if not isinstance(src, dict):
                raise ValueError('SrcTemplate is not a relationship object.')
            srcMoid = str(src.get('Moid', '')).strip()
            srcType = str(src.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()
            if not moidPattern.fullmatch(srcMoid) or not objectTypePattern.fullmatch(srcType):
                raise ValueError('SrcTemplate does not contain a usable Moid and concrete ObjectType.')
            sourceTemplatePresent = 'true'
        if sourceTemplatePresent == 'true' and confirmTemplateOverride != 'true':
            objectStatus = 'confirmation-required'
            failureStatusCode = '409'
            failureStatusMessage = 'Template override confirmation is required'
            failureErrorMessage = 'The selected object has SrcTemplate. Set Confirm Template Override to true before applying a direct PolicyBucket change.'
            failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'Moid': parentMoid, 'ObjectType': expectedObjectType, 'SrcTemplatePresent': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
        else:
            objectStatus = 'ready'
            failureStatusCode = ''
            failureStatusMessage = ''
            failureErrorMessage = ''
            failureResult = '{}'
            parentSummary = json.dumps({'Moid': parentMoid, 'Name': expectedName, 'ObjectType': expectedObjectType, 'OrganizationMoid': expectedOrganizationMoid, 'ProfileType': profileType, 'ObjectKind': objectKind, 'SrcTemplatePresent': sourceTemplatePresent == 'true'}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    objectStatus = 'invalid'
    parentMoid = ''
    failureStatusCode = '502'
    failureStatusMessage = 'Profile or template response was invalid'
    failureErrorMessage = 'The exact object response failed validation: ' + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'details': failureErrorMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))

import json
import re
import sys
expectedMoid = sys.argv[10]
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[3]
expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[9]
policyMoid = sys.argv[11]
policyObjectType = sys.argv[12]
conflictMode = sys.argv[7]
mergeState = 'invalid'
stateMessage = ''
stateResult = '{}'
patchBody = ''
expectedBucketIdentitiesJson = ''
successResult = '{}'
moidPattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')
objectTypePattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$')

def normalize_bucket(item):
    if 'PolicyBucket' not in item:
        raise ValueError('The object response omitted PolicyBucket.')
    raw = item.get('PolicyBucket')
    if raw is None:
        raw = []
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        raise ValueError('PolicyBucket is not an array or null.')
    normalized = []
    seenPairs = set()
    seenMoids = {}
    for index, value in enumerate(raw):
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket entry ' + str(index) + ' is not a relationship object.')
        moid = str(value.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        objectType = str(value.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(moid):
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket entry ' + str(index) + ' has an invalid Moid.')
        if not objectTypePattern.fullmatch(objectType):
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket entry ' + str(index) + ' has an invalid ObjectType.')
        pair = (moid, objectType)
        if pair in seenPairs:
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains a duplicate relationship identity.')
        if moid in seenMoids and seenMoids[moid] != objectType:
            raise ValueError('One PolicyBucket Moid appears with multiple ObjectTypes.')
        seenPairs.add(pair)
        seenMoids[moid] = objectType
        normalized.append({'ClassId': 'mo.MoRef', 'ObjectType': objectType, 'Moid': moid})
    return normalized
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[8])
    results = envelope.get('Results') if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(results, list) or len(results) != 1 or (not isinstance(results[0], dict)):
        raise ValueError('The validated parent response no longer contains exactly one object.')
    item = results[0]
    if str(item.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError('The parent Moid changed between lookup and merge.')
    if str(item.get('Name', '')).strip() != expectedName:
        raise ValueError('The parent Name changed between lookup and merge.')
    if str(item.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != expectedObjectType:
        raise ValueError('The parent ObjectType changed between lookup and merge.')
    organization = item.get('Organization')
    if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedOrganizationMoid or str(organization.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != 'organization.Organization':
        raise ValueError('The parent Organization relationship changed between lookup and merge.')
    bucket = normalize_bucket(item)
    if any((rel['Moid'] == policyMoid and rel['ObjectType'] != policyObjectType for rel in bucket)):
        raise ValueError('Policy Moid already appears with a different ObjectType.')
    sameTypeIndexes = [i for i, rel in enumerate(bucket) if rel['ObjectType'] == policyObjectType]
    exactIndexes = [i for i in sameTypeIndexes if bucket[i]['Moid'] == policyMoid]
    if len(sameTypeIndexes) > 1:
        raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains more than one relationship for the requested single-policy ObjectType.')
    newRelation = {'ClassId': 'mo.MoRef', 'ObjectType': policyObjectType, 'Moid': policyMoid}
    merged = list(bucket)
    operation = ''
    if len(exactIndexes) == 1:
        mergeState = 'already'
        stateMessage = 'The exact policy relationship already exists; no PATCH is required.'
        operation = 'idempotent'
    elif len(sameTypeIndexes) == 1 and conflictMode == 'Fail':
        mergeState = 'conflict'
        stateMessage = 'PolicyBucket already contains a different policy with the requested ObjectType and Conflict Mode is Fail.'
        operation = 'conflict'
    elif len(sameTypeIndexes) == 1:
        merged[sameTypeIndexes[0]] = newRelation
        mergeState = 'patch'
        stateMessage = 'The occupied same-type relationship will be replaced while every unrelated policy identity is preserved.'
        operation = 'replace'
    else:
        merged.append(newRelation)
        mergeState = 'patch'
        stateMessage = 'The policy relationship will be appended while every existing policy identity is preserved.'
        operation = 'append'
    expectedIdentities = [{'Moid': rel['Moid'], 'ObjectType': rel['ObjectType']} for rel in merged]
    expectedBucketIdentitiesJson = json.dumps(expectedIdentities, separators=(',', ':'))
    if mergeState == 'patch':
        patchBody = json.dumps({'PolicyBucket': merged}, separators=(',', ':'))
    stateResult = json.dumps({'Moid': expectedMoid, 'Name': expectedName, 'ObjectType': expectedObjectType, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid, 'PolicyObjectType': policyObjectType, 'ConflictMode': conflictMode, 'Operation': operation, 'PriorPolicyCount': len(bucket), 'ResultingPolicyCount': len(merged), 'State': mergeState}, separators=(',', ':'))
    successResult = json.dumps({'updated': mergeState == 'patch', 'idempotent': mergeState == 'already', 'Moid': expectedMoid, 'Name': expectedName, 'ObjectType': expectedObjectType, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid, 'PolicyObjectType': policyObjectType, 'Operation': operation, 'PolicyCount': len(merged)}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    mergeState = 'invalid'
    stateMessage = 'PolicyBucket merge validation failed: ' + str(exc)
    stateResult = json.dumps({'error': 'PolicyBucket merge validation failed', 'details': stateMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))

import json
import re
import sys
expectedMoid = sys.argv[10]
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[3]
expectedOrganizationMoid = sys.argv[9]
expectedIdentities = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
policyMoid = sys.argv[11]
policyObjectType = sys.argv[12]
verificationStatus = 'invalid'
verificationError = ''
verificationResult = json.dumps({'error': 'Direct PATCH response validation did not complete', 'requestMayHaveBeenAccepted': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
moidPattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')
objectTypePattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$')

def identities(raw):
    if raw is None:
        raw = []
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        raise ValueError('PolicyBucket is not an array or null.')
    answer = []
    seen = set()
    for value in raw:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains a non-object entry.')
        moid = str(value.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        objectType = str(value.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(moid) or not objectTypePattern.fullmatch(objectType):
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains an unusable relationship identity.')
        pair = (moid, objectType)
        if pair in seen:
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains a duplicate relationship identity.')
        seen.add(pair)
        answer.append(pair)
    return sorted(answer)
try:
    response = json.loads(sys.argv[8])
    if not isinstance(response, dict):
        raise ValueError('The PATCH response is not a JSON object.')
    if str(response.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError('The PATCH response Moid does not match the selected object.')
    if str(response.get('Name', '')).strip() != expectedName:
        raise ValueError('The PATCH response Name does not match the normalized requested name.')
    if str(response.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != expectedObjectType:
        raise ValueError('The PATCH response ObjectType does not match the routed concrete type.')
    organization = response.get('Organization')
    if not isinstance(organization, dict) or str(organization.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedOrganizationMoid or str(organization.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != 'organization.Organization':
        raise ValueError('The PATCH response Organization relationship does not match the resolved organization.')
    expected = sorted(((str(x.get('Moid', '')).strip(), str(x.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()) for x in expectedIdentities))
    returned = identities(response.get('PolicyBucket'))
    if returned != expected:
        raise ValueError('The returned PolicyBucket identities do not exactly equal the complete expected array.')
    if (policyMoid, policyObjectType) not in returned:
        raise ValueError('The returned PolicyBucket does not contain the requested policy relationship.')
    verificationStatus = 'valid'
    verificationResult = json.dumps({'updated': True, 'Moid': expectedMoid, 'Name': expectedName, 'ObjectType': expectedObjectType, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid, 'PolicyObjectType': policyObjectType, 'PolicyCount': len(returned)}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    verificationError = 'The accepted direct PolicyBucket response failed validation: ' + str(exc)
    verificationResult = json.dumps({'error': 'Direct PATCH response validation failed', 'details': verificationError, 'requestMayHaveBeenAccepted': True}, separators=(',', ':'))

import json
import re
import sys
parentMoid = sys.argv[12]
expectedParentObjectType = sys.argv[2]
expectedChildObjectType = sys.argv[3]
parentRelationshipName = sys.argv[4]
expectedPlatform = sys.argv[5]
switchScope = sys.argv[6]
confirmTemplateOverride = sys.argv[7]
policyMoid = sys.argv[13]
policyObjectType = sys.argv[14]
conflictMode = sys.argv[10]
mergeState = 'invalid'
stateMessage = ''
stateResult = '{}'
childAMoid = ''
childBMoid = ''
childAName = ''
childBName = ''
patchFabricA = 'false'
patchFabricB = 'false'
fabricAPatchBody = ''
fabricBPatchBody = ''
expectedAIdentitiesJson = ''
expectedBIdentitiesJson = ''
successResult = '{}'
successMessage = ''
fabricAFailureMessage = 'Fabric A update may have been accepted; Fabric B was not attempted. Inspect both selected children before retrying.'
fabricBFailureMessage = 'Fabric B update may have been accepted. Inspect every selected child before retrying.'
moidPattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')
objectTypePattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$')

def src_template_present(item, side):
    value = item.get('SrcTemplate')
    if value in (None, {}):
        return False
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' SrcTemplate is not a relationship object.')
    moid = str(value.get('Moid', '')).strip()
    objectType = str(value.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()
    if not moidPattern.fullmatch(moid) or not objectTypePattern.fullmatch(objectType):
        raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' SrcTemplate has an invalid identity.')
    return True

def normalize_bucket(item, side):
    if 'PolicyBucket' not in item:
        raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' response omitted PolicyBucket.')
    raw = item.get('PolicyBucket')
    if raw is None:
        raw = []
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' PolicyBucket is not an array or null.')
    normalized = []
    seenPairs = set()
    seenMoids = {}
    for index, value in enumerate(raw):
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' PolicyBucket entry ' + str(index) + ' is not an object.')
        moid = str(value.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        objectType = str(value.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(moid) or not objectTypePattern.fullmatch(objectType):
            raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' PolicyBucket contains an invalid relationship identity.')
        pair = (moid, objectType)
        if pair in seenPairs:
            raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' PolicyBucket contains a duplicate relationship identity.')
        if moid in seenMoids and seenMoids[moid] != objectType:
            raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' has one policy Moid with multiple ObjectTypes.')
        seenPairs.add(pair)
        seenMoids[moid] = objectType
        normalized.append({'ClassId': 'mo.MoRef', 'ObjectType': objectType, 'Moid': moid})
    return normalized

def analyze(item, side):
    bucket = normalize_bucket(item, side)
    if any((rel['Moid'] == policyMoid and rel['ObjectType'] != policyObjectType for rel in bucket)):
        raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' already contains Policy Moid with a different ObjectType.')
    sameType = [i for i, rel in enumerate(bucket) if rel['ObjectType'] == policyObjectType]
    exact = [i for i in sameType if bucket[i]['Moid'] == policyMoid]
    if len(sameType) > 1:
        raise ValueError('Child ' + side + ' contains multiple relationships for the requested single-policy ObjectType.')
    merged = list(bucket)
    relation = {'ClassId': 'mo.MoRef', 'ObjectType': policyObjectType, 'Moid': policyMoid}
    if len(exact) == 1:
        state = 'already'
        operation = 'idempotent'
    elif len(sameType) == 1 and conflictMode == 'Fail':
        state = 'conflict'
        operation = 'conflict'
    elif len(sameType) == 1:
        merged[sameType[0]] = relation
        state = 'patch'
        operation = 'replace'
    else:
        merged.append(relation)
        state = 'patch'
        operation = 'append'
    identities = [{'Moid': x['Moid'], 'ObjectType': x['ObjectType']} for x in merged]
    body = json.dumps({'PolicyBucket': merged}, separators=(',', ':')) if state == 'patch' else ''
    return {'state': state, 'operation': operation, 'body': body, 'identities': json.dumps(identities, separators=(',', ':')), 'priorCount': len(bucket), 'resultCount': len(merged)}
try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[11])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict):
        raise ValueError('The child response is not a JSON object.')
    results = envelope.get('Results')
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError('The child response does not contain a Results array.')
    if len(results) != 2:
        raise ValueError('Exactly two child switch objects are required; received ' + str(len(results)) + '.')
    sides = {'A': [], 'B': []}
    for item in results:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError('A child switch result is not an object.')
        if str(item.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != expectedChildObjectType:
            raise ValueError('A child switch result has an unexpected ObjectType.')
        moid = str(item.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        name = str(item.get('Name', '')).strip()
        side = str(item.get('SwitchId', '')).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(moid) or not name:
            raise ValueError('A child switch result is missing a usable Moid or Name.')
        if side not in sides:
            raise ValueError('Every child switch object must have SwitchId A or B.')
        parent = item.get(parentRelationshipName)
        if not isinstance(parent, dict) or str(parent.get('Moid', '')).strip() != parentMoid or str(parent.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != expectedParentObjectType:
            raise ValueError('A child switch object does not reference the exact selected parent.')
        if str(item.get('TargetPlatform', '')).strip() != expectedPlatform:
            raise ValueError('A child switch TargetPlatform does not match Profile Type.')
        sides[side].append(item)
    if len(sides['A']) != 1 or len(sides['B']) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Exactly one SwitchId A child and one SwitchId B child are required.')
    childA = sides['A'][0]
    childB = sides['B'][0]
    childAMoid = str(childA.get('Moid', '')).strip()
    childBMoid = str(childB.get('Moid', '')).strip()
    childAName = str(childA.get('Name', '')).strip()
    childBName = str(childB.get('Name', '')).strip()
    if childAMoid == childBMoid:
        raise ValueError('Child A and B Moids must be distinct.')
    selectedSides = ['A', 'B'] if switchScope == 'Both' else [switchScope]
    if switchScope == 'Both':
        fabricAFailureMessage = 'Fabric A update may have been accepted; Fabric B was not attempted. Inspect both selected children before retrying.'
    else:
        fabricAFailureMessage = 'Fabric A update may have been accepted. Inspect the selected Fabric A child before retrying.'
    selected = {'A': childA, 'B': childB}
    derived = [side for side in selectedSides if src_template_present(selected[side], side)]
    if derived and confirmTemplateOverride != 'true':
        mergeState = 'confirmation-required'
        stateMessage = 'Selected child ' + ', '.join(derived) + ' has SrcTemplate. Set Confirm Template Override to true before applying a direct PolicyBucket change.'
        stateResult = json.dumps({'error': 'Template override confirmation is required', 'derivedSides': derived, 'SwitchScope': switchScope}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        analyses = {side: analyze(selected[side], side) for side in selectedSides}
        if any((x['state'] == 'conflict' for x in analyses.values())):
            mergeState = 'conflict'
            stateMessage = 'At least one selected child already contains a different same-type policy and Conflict Mode is Fail; no child was patched.'
        elif all((x['state'] == 'already' for x in analyses.values())):
            mergeState = 'already'
            stateMessage = 'Every selected child already contains the exact policy relationship; no PATCH is required.'
        else:
            mergeState = 'patch'
            stateMessage = 'Every selected child passed preflight; only children requiring append or replace will be PATCHed.'
        if 'A' in analyses:
            expectedAIdentitiesJson = analyses['A']['identities']
            if analyses['A']['state'] == 'patch':
                patchFabricA = 'true'
                fabricAPatchBody = analyses['A']['body']
        if 'B' in analyses:
            expectedBIdentitiesJson = analyses['B']['identities']
            if analyses['B']['state'] == 'patch':
                patchFabricB = 'true'
                fabricBPatchBody = analyses['B']['body']
        if mergeState != 'patch':
            patchFabricA = 'false'
            patchFabricB = 'false'
            fabricAPatchBody = ''
            fabricBPatchBody = ''
        stateResult = json.dumps({'ParentMoid': parentMoid, 'SwitchScope': switchScope, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid, 'PolicyObjectType': policyObjectType, 'ConflictMode': conflictMode, 'ChildStates': {side: analyses[side]['state'] for side in analyses}, 'Operations': {side: analyses[side]['operation'] for side in analyses}, 'State': mergeState}, separators=(',', ':'))
        updatedSides = [side for side, flag in (('A', patchFabricA), ('B', patchFabricB)) if flag == 'true']
        successResult = json.dumps({'updated': mergeState == 'patch', 'idempotent': mergeState == 'already', 'ParentMoid': parentMoid, 'SwitchScope': switchScope, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid, 'PolicyObjectType': policyObjectType, 'UpdatedSides': updatedSides, 'VerifiedSelectedSides': selectedSides}, separators=(',', ':'))
        successMessage = 'Policy relationship verified on selected child scope ' + switchScope + '.'
        if patchFabricA == 'true':
            fabricBFailureMessage = 'Fabric B update may have been accepted after Fabric A was patched and verified. The child PATCHes are not transactional; inspect both selected children before retrying or compensating.'
        else:
            fabricBFailureMessage = 'Fabric B update may have been accepted. No Fabric A mutation was required in this run; inspect the selected child before retrying.'
except Exception as exc:
    mergeState = 'invalid'
    stateMessage = 'Child PolicyBucket preflight validation failed: ' + str(exc)
    stateResult = json.dumps({'error': 'Child PolicyBucket preflight validation failed', 'details': stateMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))

Validates exact child/parent/platform identity and requires the returned Fabric A PolicyBucket identity set to equal the complete expected array.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
expectedMoid = sys.argv[13]
expectedName = sys.argv[2]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[3]
expectedSide = sys.argv[4]
parentRelationshipName = sys.argv[5]
expectedParentMoid = sys.argv[14]
expectedParentObjectType = sys.argv[7]
expectedPlatform = sys.argv[8]
expectedIdentities = json.loads(sys.argv[9])
policyMoid = sys.argv[15]
policyObjectType = sys.argv[16]
verificationStatus = 'invalid'
verificationError = ''
verificationResult = json.dumps({'error': 'Child PATCH response validation did not complete', 'requestMayHaveBeenAccepted': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
moidPattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')
objectTypePattern = re.compile('^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$')

def identities(raw):
    if raw is None:
        raw = []
    if not isinstance(raw, list):
        raise ValueError('PolicyBucket is not an array or null.')
    answer = []
    seen = set()
    for value in raw:
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains a non-object entry.')
        moid = str(value.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        objectType = str(value.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(moid) or not objectTypePattern.fullmatch(objectType):
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains an unusable identity.')
        pair = (moid, objectType)
        if pair in seen:
            raise ValueError('PolicyBucket contains a duplicate identity.')
        seen.add(pair)
        answer.append(pair)
    return sorted(answer)
try:
    response = json.loads(sys.argv[12])
    if not isinstance(response, dict):
        raise ValueError('The child PATCH response is not a JSON object.')
    if str(response.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedMoid:
        raise ValueError('The child PATCH response Moid does not match.')
    if str(response.get('Name', '')).strip() != expectedName:
        raise ValueError('The child PATCH response Name does not match.')
    if str(response.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != expectedObjectType:
        raise ValueError('The child PATCH response ObjectType does not match.')
    if str(response.get('SwitchId', '')).strip() != expectedSide:
        raise ValueError('The child PATCH response SwitchId does not match.')
    parent = response.get(parentRelationshipName)
    if not isinstance(parent, dict) or str(parent.get('Moid', '')).strip() != expectedParentMoid or str(parent.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != expectedParentObjectType:
        raise ValueError('The child PATCH response parent relationship does not match.')
    if str(response.get('TargetPlatform', '')).strip() != expectedPlatform:
        raise ValueError('The child PATCH response TargetPlatform does not match.')
    expected = sorted(((str(x.get('Moid', '')).strip(), str(x.get('ObjectType', '')).strip()) for x in expectedIdentities))
    returned = identities(response.get('PolicyBucket'))
    if returned != expected:
        raise ValueError('The returned complete PolicyBucket identities do not equal the expected array.')
    if (policyMoid, policyObjectType) not in returned:
        raise ValueError('The returned PolicyBucket omits the requested policy relationship.')
    verificationStatus = 'valid'
    verificationResult = json.dumps({'updated': True, 'Moid': expectedMoid, 'Name': expectedName, 'ObjectType': expectedObjectType, 'SwitchId': expectedSide, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid, 'PolicyObjectType': policyObjectType, 'PolicyCount': len(returned)}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    verificationError = 'The accepted child PolicyBucket response failed validation: ' + str(exc)
    verificationResult = json.dumps({'error': 'Child PATCH response validation failed', 'details': verificationError, 'requestMayHaveBeenAccepted': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
